نستقصص (form X)
# نَسْتَقْصِصْ (nastaqṣiṣ) /nas.taq.sˤisˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَقَصَّ (istaqaṣṣa)
# نُسْتَقْصَصْ (nustaqṣaṣ) /nus.taq.sˤasˤ/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِسْتَقَصَّ (istaqaṣṣa)
